01

Using this website

These terms cover the Favorite Hearts information website, including its articles, help pages, and contact links. By using the website, you agree to use it lawfully and in accordance with these terms. They do not create a paid subscription or a contract for a matching service. If you do not agree, please stop using the website.

02

Who the website is for

Favorite Hearts is intended for adults aged 18 and over who are interested in matrimony. If you enquire on behalf of another adult, be clear about your role and ensure you have appropriate authority to share their information. A family member’s involvement does not replace the candidate’s own choice.

03

Current and planned features

This website currently provides information and contact options. Registration, profile publishing, matching, payment processing, and verification are not available here. Descriptions of planned features explain our intended direction and may change. Specific service terms, pricing, and privacy information must be provided before those features are offered.

04

Respectful and lawful use

Do not impersonate someone, submit misleading information, harass others, send unlawful content, misuse contact channels, or share information you are not authorised to share. Do not attempt to bypass access controls, disrupt the website, introduce malicious software, or extract personal information through unauthorised means.

05

Articles and website content

Our relationship articles provide general ideas and information. They are not personalised legal, financial, medical, or psychological advice. An introduction, recommendation, or paid service cannot guarantee compatibility, a relationship, or marriage. Decisions about relationships remain with the people involved.

06

Payments and subscriptions

This website does not collect payments or activate subscriptions. Do not treat descriptions of future plans as an instruction to transfer money. Confirm any payment instructions directly with Favorite Hearts. Prices, subscription periods, cancellation terms, and any refund conditions will need to be provided before a paid service is offered. Nothing here removes rights that apply under consumer law.

07

Content and intellectual property

The website’s text, design, branding, and other materials may be protected by intellectual property rights belonging to Favorite Hearts or their respective owners. You may browse and share links for personal use. Do not reproduce or commercially reuse protected material without permission unless the law allows it. Third-party photographs, logos, and platform names remain subject to their owners’ rights.

08

External services

WhatsApp, social networks, email services, and other linked websites operate independently and have their own terms. A link does not guarantee their availability, content, or security. Check that a social profile belongs to the intended business before sharing information; some links currently lead to a search rather than a verified profile.

09

Privacy and communications

Our Privacy Policy explains this website’s privacy scope and contact options. Please keep sensitive information out of initial messages. Support hours are listed on our Contact Us page; a message sent outside those hours may be handled later. Favorite Hearts support is not an emergency service.

10

Availability and responsibility

We aim to keep the website useful and accurate, but content may contain errors and access may be interrupted or changed. Please contact us if something appears incorrect. Nothing in these terms excludes or limits liability or rights that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited. Any other limitation is subject to applicable law.

11

Changes to these terms

We may revise these website terms as the site develops and will update the date above. New product features may require additional terms and an appropriate acceptance process. A later update does not remove rights or obligations that already apply under law.

12

Questions and concerns

Contact Favorite Hearts at hello@favoritehearts.com if you have a question or concern about these terms. Please describe the issue and give us an opportunity to respond. Nothing in these terms prevents you from seeking assistance or exercising rights through a competent regulator or court.
